mcrc_pt01_kras_g12d_cetuximab_resistant.title: Patient mCRC-01: Primary Sigmoid Colon Adenocarcinoma with KRAS G12D Resistance
mcrc_pt01_kras_g12d_cetuximab_resistant.citation: CALGB/SWOG 80405; TCGA-COAD; Misale et al. (2012) Nature

clinical_history.primary_driver: KRAS G12D activating mutation, APC biallelic loss, TP53 mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Immediate disease progression (PD), multiple bilobar liver metastases at 3.2 months, death at 10.4 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Constitutive KRAS G12D GTPase signaling downstream of EGFR bypasses antibody inhibition, maintaining uninterrupted ERK/PI3K flux

mcrc_pt02_braf_v600e_fulminant_peritonea.title: Patient mCRC-02: Right-Sided Ascending Colon with Fulminant BRAF V600E Carcinomatosis
mcrc_pt02_braf_v600e_fulminant_peritonea.citation: Kopetz et al. (2019) NEJM BEACON CRC Trial; Yaeger et al. (2018) Cancer Discovery

clinical_history.primary_driver: BRAF V600E mutation, APC loss, SMAD4 deletion
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Aggressive peritoneal carcinomatosis, malignant ascites and bowel obstruction at 2.8 months, death at 6.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: BRAF V600E drives rapid feedback activation of EGFR and hyper-activates BCL-xL and MCL-1, rendering triplet chemo completely ineffective

mcrc_pt03_egfr_wt_acquired_met_amplified.title: Patient mCRC-03: RAS-WT Left Colon with Acquired c-MET Amplification Under Anti-EGFR
mcrc_pt03_egfr_wt_acquired_met_amplified.citation: Bardelli et al. (2013) Cancer Discovery; Pietrantonio et al. (2017) Clin Cancer Res

clinical_history.primary_driver: Focal c-MET gene amplification emerging post-Panitumumab, APC loss
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Initial partial response for 6.4 months, then rapid secondary progression in liver and lungs, death at 14.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Emergence of c-MET genomic amplification serves as an autocrine survival bypass reactivating both MAPK and PI3K despite EGFR blockade

mcrc_pt04_msi_high_immunotherapy_excepti.title: Patient mCRC-04: Cecal MSI-High / dMMR Exceptional Immunotherapy Cured Survivor
mcrc_pt04_msi_high_immunotherapy_excepti.citation: Andre et al. (2020) NEJM KEYNOTE-177; Diaz et al. (2017) Science

clinical_history.primary_driver: High mutational burden, wild-type KRAS/BRAF, intact TP53 apoptotic signaling
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete pathological and radiological response (CR), ongoing disease-free remission >48 months (SURVIVED / Cured)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Intact intrinsic apoptotic cascade; lack of downstream anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 blocks allows rapid caspase-mediated tumor destruction

mcrc_pt05_pi3k_pten_double_hit_refractor.title: Patient mCRC-05: Rectal Adenocarcinoma with PIK3CA-E545K and PTEN Null Resistance
mcrc_pt05_pi3k_pten_double_hit_refractor.citation: De Roock et al. (2010) Lancet Oncology; TCGA-READ Consortium

clinical_history.primary_driver: Activating PIK3CA-E545K mutation, PTEN deletion, APC loss, TP53 mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Chemo-refractory, pelvic recurrence and rapid pulmonary metastases at 4.0 months, death at 9.0 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Dual hit on PI3K/Akt pathway constitutively hyper-activates Akt, hyper-stabilizing XIAP and MCL-1 against oxaliplatin DNA adducts

mcrc_pt06_wnt_driven_myc_hyperactivated.title: Patient mCRC-06: Familial APC Truncation with Massive Wnt/MYC Transcriptional Amplification
mcrc_pt06_wnt_driven_myc_hyperactivated.citation: Zhan et al. (2017) Oncogene; Dow et al. (2015) Cell (APC restoration in CRC)

clinical_history.primary_driver: Biallelic APC truncation, nuclear beta-catenin hyper-accumulation, high MYC expression, TP53 mut
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Rapid hepatic and splenic metastases at 3.8 months, refractory to second-line therapies, death at 8.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Unchecked nuclear TCF4/beta-catenin drives high CyclinD1 and MYC transcription, suppressing BAX pore formation and overriding G1 arrest

mcrc_pt07_hypoxic_stem_liver_metastasis.title: Patient mCRC-07: Hypoxic Liver Metastases with Cancer Stem Cell Dormancy
mcrc_pt07_hypoxic_stem_liver_metastasis.citation: Dieter et al. (2011) Cell Stem Cell; Grothey et al. (2013) Lancet CORRECT Trial

clinical_history.primary_driver: KRAS G12V mutation, APC loss, high HGF and TGF-beta stromal expression, severe hypoxia
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Drug-induced toxic hepatitis, progressive hepatomegaly with necrotic tumor expansion at 2.9 months, death at 5.5 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Hypoxic cancer stem cells activate STAT3/NF-kB, driving robust MCL-1 and c-FLIP expression to completely silence death receptor caspases

mcrc_pt08_pan_refractory_triplet_mutant.title: Patient mCRC-08: Heavily Pretreated Pan-Refractory Quadruple Pathway Colorectal Carcinoma
mcrc_pt08_pan_refractory_triplet_mutant.citation: Mayer et al. (2015) NEJM RECOURSE Trial; Dasari et al. (2023) Lancet FRESCO-2 Trial

clinical_history.primary_driver: Concurrent KRAS G12D, PIK3CA H1047R, APC loss, TP53 mut, high MET and EGFR co-expression
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Progression-free survival of 1.8 months, disseminated carcinomatosis and hepatic failure, death at 4.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Simultaneous signaling across MAPK, PI3K, and Wnt pathways establishes a triple-tier anti-apoptotic lock (MCL1 + BCLxL + XIAP)
